Job Title 
 Full-stack AI Developer Intern 
 Location(s) 
 CAD Remote – ON 
 About Us 
 
 Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health. 
 
 Find your future at Revvity 
 
 About Revvity: 
At Revvity, we're leaders in the human diagnostics and life sciences industry, delivering cutting-edge lab instruments, reagents, and top-level scientific software. We're now embarking on an exciting journey to harness the power of AI across our entire organization. We envision a future where AI enhances creativity, boosts productivity, and unlocks new potential in every aspect of our business. Our dedicated team is pioneering the integration of AI-driven technologies to help our employees work smarter, faster, and more innovatively. We're committed to responsible AI development that improves business outcomes while upholding our core values. If you're seeking a meaningful, impactful, and stimulating internship in enterprise AI application, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

 About you: 
You're passionate about artificial intelligence, with a particular interest in how generative AI and large language models (LLMs) can transform business operations. You embody our core values: 
 
• Embrace the unknown: You start each day with a "What if?" mindset, ready to explore how AI can revolutionize traditional business processes. 
• Partner with purpose: You're excited to work alongside diverse teams, using AI to accelerate positive outcomes across all departments. 
• Passion for people: You understand that AI's true potential lies in augmenting human capabilities, not replacing them. 
• Collaborate for success: You thrive in team environments, putting collective goals before individual recognition, and valuing transparency and integrity in your work. You're a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited by the prospect of applying cutting-edge AI technologies to real-world business challenges. Job Responsibilities: What you'll do:

 Within 30 days 
 
• Complete onboarding, gaining familiarity with our enterprise systems and ongoing AI initiatives 
• Provide feedback on your onboarding experience, embodying our value of continuous improvement 
• Build relationships across various departments to understand their unique challenges and AI opportunities 
• Gain a basic understanding of our business operations and how AI can enhance productivity Beyond 60 days 
 
• Develop prototypes and proofs-of-concept for AI-powered features that can boost employee productivity and creativity 
• Contribute to the development of prompt engineering strategies for various business applications 
• Participate in creating AI-driven tools that can be integrated into our existing workflow systems 
• Collaborate on AI model integration projects, ensuring seamless user experiences across different platforms 
• Assist in evaluating and benchmarking AI performance against business KPIs and user satisfaction metrics 
• Present your work and findings to stakeholders, translating complex AI concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences Required Skills:Requirements: 
 
• Strong interest in enterprise AI applications 
• Familiarity with popular LLMs such as ChatGPT, Claude, or others 
• Familiarity with python, Next.JS, Docker and full stack technologies 
• Basic understanding of prompt engineering concepts 
• Proficiency in at least one programming language (js preferred) 
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment 
• Strong problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail 
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal 
• Bonus: Understanding of business processes and enterprise software systems 
 Our Values in Action: 
 
• Embrace the unknown: Be prepared to tackle unprecedented challenges in applying AI to diverse business functions. 
• Partner with purpose: Collaborate closely with employees across all levels to understand and meet their AI-driven needs. 
• Passion for people: Focus on developing AI solutions that empower and uplift our workforce. 
• Collaborate for success: Embrace teamwork, transparency, and integrity as we integrate AI into our corporate culture. Using the " OCEAN " model which stands for Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism, we're looking for the following personality traits:

 Openness - The ability to take on new challenges and learn new things.
 Conscientiousness - The ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work.
 Extraversion - The ability to communicate directly with customers and users, and to present your work clearly and effectively to different stakeholders as needed.
 Agreeableness - Be kind and thoughtful. We value people who are respectful of others and who are willing to jump in and help where and when needed.
 Neuroticism - Although we try and minimize stress levels, there will be deadlines to meet. Plans can change, so the ability to pivot and adapt to changing priorities will be important.

This internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI application. Join us in shaping the future of AI-driven business innovation and employee empowerment!
fit_why: Full-stack and LLM/RAG work match his QuestLog and RKJ experience closely

Who We Are: 
 Muniworth is an innovative SaaS startup dedicated to municipal financial forecasting, empowering local governments to optimize budgeting and strategic financial planning. We are currently building a machine learning (ML) and AI team to develop internal tooling, enhance our web applications, and create customized solutions for our municipal clients. If you're passionate about leveraging Natural Language Processing (NLP), ML, and AI to drive impactful real-world solutions, Muniworth offers a perfect learning environment.
 Who You Are: 
 You're a curious, motivated Computer Science student with exposure to NLP, ML, and AI concepts. You value writing robust, type-safe code, and you're interested in modelling real-world domains precisely. You're eager to join a collaborative team where you'll have significant opportunities to contribute meaningfully. Confident yet eager to learn, you're excited to take on responsibilities and grow alongside experienced developers.
 What You'll Do: 
 
• Support the design, build, and deployment of data processing pipelines and infrastructure by leveraging NLP, ML, LLMs and AI. 
• Write type-safe, maintainable code following software engineering best practices - while this is a co-op role, you should be motivated to create readable, well-structured solutions that support collaborative development. 
• Work closely with our Lead Engineer and ML/AI team on projects leveraging classical ML techniques as well as NLP, LLMs, and retrieval augmented generation (RAG). 
• Assist in optimizing model performance and scalability, building hands-on experience with AI frameworks, model optimization, and cloud computing platforms. 
• Contribute to customized AI-driven solutions for municipal clients, gaining insight into how advanced analytics and stakeholder requirements influence product direction and development strategy. 
• Take on specific AI-focused projects with mentorship and guidance, gaining experience across development, maintenance, performance monitoring, and exploration of new AI approaches and techniques.

What You Bring: 
 
• Enrollment in a Computer Science program (or related discipline) with completed coursework in ML and AI fundamentals. 
• Some practical experience in data science, including implementing ML, NLP, or LLM-based solutions using libraries and tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face. 
• Ability to critically think about ML or AI problems, including evaluating performance and identifying potential biases or limitations. 
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, essential for thriving in a collaborative team environment. 
• Willingness to commit to a minimum 8-month term, with potential to extend up to one year. 
• Experience working with cloud-based AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry is a plus

Why Join Muniworth: 
 
• Flexible work schedule (40 hours/week). 
• Dedicated 1-on-1 mentorship and substantial professional development opportunities. 
• Integrated and supportive team culture emphasizing learning, collaboration, and innovation. 
• Modern, vibrant office centrally located in downtown Victoria, BC—100% in-person role. 
• Frequent social events and team-building activities (optional). 
• Opportunity to directly impact the success of local governments and communities through meaningful projects. Hiring Process: 
 We're actively recruiting for a January start date. If you're excited by the possibility of substantial professional growth, ready to contribute meaningfully, and eager to join a team passionate about machine learning and artificial intelligence, we’d love to hear from you!
fit_why: Strong fit: RAG/LLM experience, Python, classical ML/NLP-adjacent co-op
